messages:
ranjit: morning team, quick onboarding snag. I can access Console but when I try to run a small e2e in staging that flips a flag I get a permissions error. Need to flip `payments.enable_experiment` for a 10-user canary. Who should I ask for a short-lived toggle role?
tess: hey Ranjit, welcome! For toggles in staging we have `console:staging-ff-toggle`. That requires owner sign-off but infra can grant a timeboxed role if owners approve. What's your employee id and timeline?
ranjit: id 11777. Need the toggle for about 2 hours this afternoon (UTC-7). I already pinged the payments team in a DM. Is there a preferred approval format?
tess: nice. Owners typically reply in the ticket or in-thread with explicit approval. Quick template: `approver: @dev-payments; reason: e2e canary for experiment; flags: payments.enable_experiment; duration: 2h; id: 11777`. Paste that into #infra-access or open the web form.
ranjit: opened a ticket and linked the approvals DM. Ticket #INFR-5120. Link: https://redwood.internal/infr/INFR-5120
infra-bot: [automated] Access request INFR-5120 created by ranjit. Status: pending owner approvals.
dev-payments: dev-payments here  we saw the DM and approve a 2-hour canary for non-billing experiments. Please ensure the canary users are behind the experiment cohort and that you monitor metrics.
ranjit: thanks so much. One thing: my local test harness needs to call the Console API with a token. Do we allow service tokens for short toggles or must it be human SSO?
tess: for interactive toggles prefer human SSO. For automation use a service account but it must be requested separately and tied to the ticket; we issue short-lived credentials and audit them. For a 2-hour manual canary, SSO is fine.
ranjit: copy. Also saw an audit log setting in Console. Will my toggle show up in the FF audit? I want to prove the change was limited.
dev-payments: toggles done via Console are recorded in the FF audit and you can attach the audit link to your postmortem. If you use the API with a service token, the actor will show as the service identity.
ranjit: perfect. If owners are slow to respond, can infra grant provisional toggle rights and then require post-hoc approval?
tess: infra can only grant provisional roles with explicit owner opt-in. We can fast-track requests from folks on a ramp/mentor list, but we still need at least one owner ack. For emergencies, owners can tag `@eng-sre` and we follow the emergency flip playbook.
ranjit: understood. For visibility, tagging @tess and @dev-payments in the ticket so approvers see it. Thanks for the quick answers!
infra-bot: [automated] INFR-5120 updated: owner dev-payments approved. Access window scheduled 14:00-16:00 UTC-7.
ranjit: got it, will run the canary at 14:10 and post results. Appreciate the support :thumbsup:
